skill_name: Give an example of a time when you had to think outside the box.
workflow: One time I had to think outside the box was when I was working on a project and encountered a problem that nobody had encountered before. The problem seemed insurmountable, as no one had any ideas or solutions to the problem. Instead of giving up, I stepped back and looked at the problem from a different perspective.
